prompt_en: A coherent complex fashion photograph shows a person wearing visibly constructed clothing, an explicitly adult woman pausing in the concrete entrance vestibule of a new civic library at the beginning of an architecture tour. The visible face and dark bob haircut follow the attached appearance reference. Her calmly attentive gaze meets the camera with a faint, relaxed smile; the portrayal emphasizes her composed presence. She stands almost frontal with her weight on the rear leg and the other foot slightly forward, both soles resting on the level floor, arms relaxed slightly away from her hips. Her contemporary dark teal knee-length tailored dress has curved princess seams running from the armholes across the bust into the fitted waist. Its sweetheart neckline has a shaped teal boundary: the bodice upper edge forms two rounded arcs, and the two curved arcs meet at a visible central dip. Long gigot sleeves have generous shoulder-and-upper-arm volume tapering closely from the elbows to the wrists. Narrow raised ivory piping follows the sweetheart edge and both cuffs. Each hip welt pocket is a narrow horizontal opening framed by two slim fabric lips; both openings remain exposed beside her relaxed hands. An inverted box pleat at the center front of the skirt has two inward-facing folded edges meeting at the center, with a recessed fold and soft shadow beneath them. On her bare upper chest rests a pendant suspended at the center of a neck chain. The silver connector supports its small rectangle: a small bail is visibly attached at the top of the pendant, and the necklace chain visibly passes through the bail opening. Black leather Derby shoes have open lacing: separate eyelet-bearing quarters sit on top of each vamp, their loose edges opening into a clear V around the tongues. The clothing construction is visibly readable. Soft late-morning skylight and a narrow side-window beam rake across the stitched seams and folds. Head-to-toe portrait framing gives the woman most of the image height, keeps the neckline and pendant connection, both sleeve silhouettes, pocket mouths, skirt folds and both shoe uppers legible together, and leaves quiet concrete geometry around her.
